nodes.long_description: Πάρτε το τιμόνι της δικαιοσύνης! Το Cop Drive φέρνει την πιο συναρπαστική εμπειρία οδήγησης στο VR. Χαρακτηριστικά: Στόλος περιπολικών, neon πίστες στον ουρανό, ρεαλιστικός χειρισμός VR και δράση χωρίς σταμάτημα.
nodes.short_description: Προσδεθείτε για την απόλυτη εμπειρία ακροβατικών με περιπολικό! Οδηγήστε αυτοκίνητα υψηλών επιδόσεων σε γιγάντιες ράμπες στον ουρανό και εκτελέστε τρελά άλματα σε έναν 3D κόσμο.

nodes.long_description: ¡Toma el volante de la justicia en un desafío de acrobacias aéreas! Cop Drive ofrece el simulador de conducción policial más emocionante en VR. Características: flota de élite, pistas de neón imposibles, conducción táctil VR y acción sin límites.
nodes.short_description: ¡Abróchate el cinturón para la mejor experiencia de acrobacias policiales! Conduce patrullas de alto rendimiento en mega rampas celestiales y domina pistas imposibles en 3D.

nodes.long_description:
Take the Wheel of Justice in a High-Flying Stunt Challenge!

Get ready to experience the most thrilling police car driving simulator in VR. In Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt, you aren't just patrolling the streets—you’re taking your driving skills to the sky! From the high-tech garage to the clouds, test your precision on massive ramps and stunt tracks designed to push your reflexes to the edge.

Why You Will Love It:
Elite Police Fleet: Step into a detailed 3D garage to select your high-performance squad car. Each vehicle features a polished interior and realistic physics tailored for Meta Quest.

Impossible Sky Tracks: Navigate through vibrant, neon-lit environments featuring loops, massive jumps, and rotating obstacles high above the horizon.

Tactile VR Driving: Use your controllers to master the steering and speed. Feel the rush of every jump and the tension of every narrow turn with responsive VR controls.

Action-Packed Progression: Face increasingly difficult stages that require perfect timing and nerves of steel to reach the finish line.

Cinematic Stunt Experience: Enjoy a visually stunning world with smooth animations and satisfying sound effects that make every successful stunt feel epic.

Whether you're hitting the nitro for a massive gap or carefully balancing on a narrow beam, Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt offers non-stop adrenaline. Grab your headset, hit the gas, and start your stunt career today!
nodes.short_description: Buckle up for the ultimate police car stunt experience! In Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt, you take the wheel of high-performance squad cars on sky-high mega ramps. Perform insane flips, navigate moving obstacles, and master impossible tracks in a fully immersive 3D world. It’s a fast-paced, high-octane challenge for every driving fan—can you handle the height?

nodes.long_description: Ta rattet i en luftig stuntutfordring! Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt er den mest spennende kjøresimulatoren i VR. Funksjoner: Elite politibiler, neon-belyste baner i skyene, taktil VR-styring og actionfylt progresjon på Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Spenn deg fast for den ultimate politibil-stuntopplevelsen! Kjør kraftige patruljebiler på enorme ramper i skyene og mestre umulige baner i en fullstendig 3D-verden.

nodes.long_description: Przejmij kierownicę sprawiedliwości! Cop Drive to najbardziej emocjonujący symulator jazdy policją w VR. Cechy: elita policyjnych aut, neonowe podniebne trasy, intuicyjne sterowanie VR i pełna adrenaliny rozgrywka.
nodes.short_description: Zapnij pasy i weź udział w kaskaderskich wyścigach radiowozem! Kieruj potężnymi autami na gigantycznych rampach w chmurach i wykonuj szalone ewolucje w świecie 3D.

nodes.long_description: 하늘을 나는 스턴트 챌린지에서 정의의 핸들을 잡으세요! Cop Drive는 VR에서 가장 스릴 넘치는 경찰차 운전 시뮬레이터입니다. 특징: 정교한 3D 차고, 네온 조명 스카이 트랙, 실감나는 VR 컨트롤 및 액션 가득한 게임 플레이.
nodes.short_description: 최고의 경찰차 스턴트 경험을 위해 안전벨트를 매세요! 하늘 높이 솟은 메가 램프에서 고성능 순찰차를 운전하고, 3D 몰입형 세계에서 불가능한 트랙을 정복하세요.

nodes.long_description: Oplev spændingen ved kørsel i højden! Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt udfordrer dine evner på massive ramper. Funktioner: Detaljeret garage med politibiler, neon-oplyste baner, præcis VR-styring og actionfyldt progression.
nodes.short_description: Spænd sikkerhedsselen til den ultimative politibil-stuntoplevelse! Tag rattet i højtydende patruljevogne på mega-ramper i skyerne. Udfør vanvittige flips og mestr umulige baner i 3D.

nodes.long_description: Adalet direksiyonuna geçin! Cop Drive, VR'daki en heyecan verici sürüş simülatörüdür. Özellikler: Seçkin polis filosu, neon ışıklı gökyüzü pistleri, dokunsal VR sürüşü ve aksiyon dolu ilerleme sistemi.
nodes.short_description: En iyi polis arabası akrobasi deneyimi için emniyet kemerinizi bağlayın! Gökyüzündeki devasa rampalarda yüksek performanslı araçları sürün ve imkansız pistlerde ustalaşın.

nodes.long_description: Prenez le volant de la justice dans un défi de cascades aériennes ! Cop Drive propose le simulateur de conduite le plus palpitant en VR. Caractéristiques : flotte de police d'élite, circuits néon impossibles et conduite VR tactile sur Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Attachez vos ceintures pour l'expérience ultime de cascades en voiture de police ! Pilotez des voitures sur des méga-rampes célestes et réalisez des flips fous dans un monde 3D.

nodes.long_description: Assuma o volante da justiça em um desafio de acrobacias aéreas! Cop Drive oferece o simulador de condução policial mais emocionante em VR. Recursos: frota de elite, pistas neon impossíveis, condução VR tátil e progressão cheia de ação.
nodes.short_description: Prepare-se para a experiência definitiva de acrobacias com carros de polícia! Dirija viaturas de alta performance em mega rampas no céu e domine pistas impossíveis em 3D.

nodes.long_description: VRで正義のハンドルを握れ！『Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt』は、スリル満点の警察車両シミュレーターです。特徴：詳細な3Dガレージ、ネオンに彩られた空中コース、直感的なMeta Quest操作、そしてアドレナリン全開のアクション体験。
nodes.short_description: 究極のパトカー・スタント体験に備えよう！超巨大なメガランプで高性能なパトカーを操り、空中の不可能を可能にするスタントに挑む、没入型3Dドライビング・チャレンジ。

nodes.long_description: Koe oikeudenmukaisuuden ajo korkeuksissa! Cop Drive tuo jännittävimmän ajo-simulaattorin VR:ään. Ominaisuudet: Eliittipoliisiautot, neonvalaistut radat, tarkka VR-ohjaus ja adrenaliinia täynnä oleva eteneminen.
nodes.short_description: Valmistaudu äärimmäiseen poliisiauton temppukokemukseen! Ohjaa tehokkaita autoja jättiläismäisillä rampeilla taivaalla. Tee huikeita hyppyjä ja hallitse mahdottomat radat 3D-maailmassa.

nodes.long_description: Übernimm das Steuer der Gerechtigkeit! Cop Drive bietet den spannendsten Fahrsimulator in VR. Features: Elite-Polizeiflotte, neonbeleuchtete Himmelsstrecken, taktiles VR-Fahren und actiongeladene Level auf der Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Schnallen Sie sich an für das ultimative Polizeiauto-Stunterlebnis! Steuern Sie Hochleistungs-Streifenwagen auf Mega-Rampen in den Wolken und meistern Sie unmögliche Strecken in 3D.

nodes.long_description: Ta ratten i en flygande stuntutmaning! Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt är den mest spännande körsimulatorn i VR. Funktioner: Elit-polisflotta, neonbelysta banor i molnen, taktil VR-styrning och actionfylld progression på Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Spänn fast dig för den ultimata polisbils-stuntupplevelsen! Kör kraftfulla patrullbilar på enorma ramper i skyn och bemästra omöjliga banor i en uppslukande 3D-värld.

nodes.long_description: Возьмите руль правосудия в свои руки! Cop Drive — это самый захватывающий симулятор вождения в VR. Особенности: элитный автопарк полиции, неоновые трассы в облаках, тактильное управление в VR и динамичный игровой процесс.
nodes.short_description: Пристегнитесь для экстремальных трюков на полицейских машинах! Управляйте мощными патрульными авто на гигантских рампах в небе и покоряйте безумные трассы в 3D.

nodes.long_description: Prendi il volante della giustizia in una sfida ad alta quota! Cop Drive offre il simulatore di guida più emozionante in VR. Caratteristiche: flotta di polizia d'élite, piste neon impossibili, guida VR tattile e progressione ricca di azione.
nodes.short_description: Allaccia le cinture per l'ultima sfida di acrobazie con la polizia! Guida auto ad alte prestazioni su mega rampe nel cielo, esegui flip folli e domina piste impossibili in 3D.

nodes.long_description: Ia volanul justiției într-o provocare de cascadorii la înălțime! Cop Drive oferă cel mai palpitant simulator de condus în VR. Caracteristici: flotă de poliție de elită, trasee neon imposibile, control VR tactil și progresie plină de acțiune.
nodes.short_description: Pune-ți centura pentru experiența supremă de cascadorii cu poliția! Condu mașini de patrulă pe mega rampe la înălțime și stăpânește trasee imposibile într-o lume 3D.

nodes.long_description: Assume o volante da justiça num desafio de acrobacias aéreas! Cop Drive oferece o simulador de condução policial mais emocionante em VR. Características: frota de elite, pistas neon impossíveis, condução VR tátil e progressão cheia de ação.
nodes.short_description: Prepara-te para a experiência definitiva de acrobacias com carros de polícia! Conduz viaturas de alta performance em mega rampas no céu e domina pistas impossíveis em 3D.

nodes.long_description: Neem het stuur over in een spectaculaire stuntuitdaging! In Cop Drive breng je je rijvaardigheid naar de wolken. Kenmerken: elite politievloot, neonverlichte luchtbanen, voelbare VR-besturing en actievolle levels op Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Maak je klaar voor de ultieme politie-stuntervaring! Bestuur snelle politiewagens op enorme schansen in de lucht. Voer krankzinnige flips uit en overwin onmogelijke tracks in een 3D-wereld.

nodes.long_description: 在雲端挑戰中掌握正義之輪！體驗VR中最令人心跳加速的警車駕駛模擬。特色：精銳警車車隊、炫酷的霓虹天空賽道、觸感真實的VR駕駛控制、以及充滿挑戰的關卡進度，盡在 Meta Quest。
nodes.short_description: 系好安全帶，體驗極致警車特技！在《Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt》中，駕駛高性能警車挑戰雲端巨型坡道。在沉浸式3D世界中完成瘋狂翻轉，征服不可能的賽道。

nodes.long_description: Take the Wheel of Justice in a High-Flying Stunt Challenge! Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt offers the most thrilling driving simulator in VR. Features: Detailed 3D garage, impossible sky tracks with loops and jumps, and responsive tactile VR controls for Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Buckle up for the ultimate police car stunt experience! Master high-performance squad cars on sky-high mega ramps with insane flips and impossible tracks in a fully immersive 3D world.

nodes.long_description: 在云端挑战中掌握正义之轮！体验VR中最令人心跳加速的警车驾驶模拟。特色：精锐警车车队、炫酷的霓虹天空赛道、触感真实的VR驾驶控制、以及充满挑战的关卡进度，尽在 Meta Quest。
nodes.short_description: 系好安全带，体验极致警车特技！在《Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt》中，驾驶高性能警车挑战云端巨型坡道。在沉浸式3D世界中完成疯狂翻转，征服不可能的赛道。

nodes.long_description: Cầm lái công lý trong thử thách nhào lộn trên không! Cop Drive mang đến giả lập lái xe cảnh sát hồi hộp nhất trong VR. Đặc điểm: đội xe cảnh sát tinh nhuệ, đường đua neon trên mây, điều khiển VR chân thực và tiến trình đầy kịch tính.
nodes.short_description: Thắt dây an toàn cho trải nghiệm nhào lộn xe cảnh sát đỉnh cao! Lái những chiếc xe tuần tra trên các siêu dốc cao vút, thực hiện những cú lộn nhào điên rồ trong thế giới 3D.

nodes.long_description: Staňte se mistrem kaskadérů v oblacích! Cop Drive přináší nejnapínavější simulátor policejní jízdy ve VR. Vlastnosti: Elitní policejní flotila, tratě na obloze s neonovým osvětlením, taktilní VR řízení a adrenalinové výzvy na Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Připoutejte se pro ultimátní policejní kaskadérský zážitek! Ovládejte výkonná auta na obřích rampách v oblacích, provádějte šílené triky a zdolávejte nemožné tratě v pohlcujícím 3D světě.

nodes.short_description: Allaccia le cinture per l'ultima sfida di acrobazie con la polizia! Guida auto ad alte prestazioni su mega rampe nel cielo, esegui flip folli e domina piste impossibili in 3D.

nodes.long_description: Ia volanul justiției într-o provocare de cascadorii la înălțime! Cop Drive oferă cel mai palpitant simulator de condus în VR. Caracteristici: flotă de poliție de elită, trasee neon imposibile, control VR tactil și progresie plină de acțiune.
nodes.short_description: Pune-ți centura pentru experiența supremă de cascadorii cu poliția! Condu mașini de patrulă pe mega rampe la înălțime și stăpânește trasee imposibile într-o lume 3D.

nodes.long_description: Assume o volante da justiça num desafio de acrobacias aéreas! Cop Drive oferece o simulador de condução policial mais emocionante em VR. Características: frota de elite, pistas neon impossíveis, condução VR tátil e progressão cheia de ação.
nodes.short_description: Prepara-te para a experiência definitiva de acrobacias com carros de polícia! Conduz viaturas de alta performance em mega rampas no céu e domina pistas impossíveis em 3D.

nodes.long_description: Neem het stuur over in een spectaculaire stuntuitdaging! In Cop Drive breng je je rijvaardigheid naar de wolken. Kenmerken: elite politievloot, neonverlichte luchtbanen, voelbare VR-besturing en actievolle levels op Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Maak je klaar voor de ultieme politie-stuntervaring! Bestuur snelle politiewagens op enorme schansen in de lucht. Voer krankzinnige flips uit en overwin onmogelijke tracks in een 3D-wereld.

nodes.long_description: 在雲端挑戰中掌握正義之輪！體驗VR中最令人心跳加速的警車駕駛模擬。特色：精銳警車車隊、炫酷的霓虹天空賽道、觸感真實的VR駕駛控制、以及充滿挑戰的關卡進度，盡在 Meta Quest。
nodes.short_description: 系好安全帶，體驗極致警車特技！在《Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt》中，駕駛高性能警車挑戰雲端巨型坡道。在沉浸式3D世界中完成瘋狂翻轉，征服不可能的賽道。

nodes.long_description: Take the Wheel of Justice in a High-Flying Stunt Challenge! Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt offers the most thrilling driving simulator in VR. Features: Detailed 3D garage, impossible sky tracks with loops and jumps, and responsive tactile VR controls for Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Buckle up for the ultimate police car stunt experience! Master high-performance squad cars on sky-high mega ramps with insane flips and impossible tracks in a fully immersive 3D world.

nodes.long_description: ¡Toma el volante de la justicia en un desafío de acrobacias aéreas! Cop Drive ofrece el simulador de conducción policial más emocionante en VR. Características: flota de élite, pistas de neón imposibles, conducción táctil VR y acción sin límites.
nodes.short_description: ¡Abróchate el cinturón para la mejor experiencia de acrobacias policiales! Conduce patrullas de alto rendimiento en mega rampas celestiales y domina pistas imposibles en 3D.

nodes.long_description: 在云端挑战中掌握正义之轮！体验VR中最令人心跳加速的警车驾驶模拟。特色：精锐警车车队、炫酷的霓虹天空赛道、触感真实的VR驾驶控制、以及充满挑战的关卡进度，尽在 Meta Quest。
nodes.short_description: 系好安全带，体验极致警车特技！在《Cop Drive: Extreme Car Stunt》中，驾驶高性能警车挑战云端巨型坡道。在沉浸式3D世界中完成疯狂翻转，征服不可能的赛道。

nodes.long_description: Cầm lái công lý trong thử thách nhào lộn trên không! Cop Drive mang đến giả lập lái xe cảnh sát hồi hộp nhất trong VR. Đặc điểm: đội xe cảnh sát tinh nhuệ, đường đua neon trên mây, điều khiển VR chân thực và tiến trình đầy kịch tính.
nodes.short_description: Thắt dây an toàn cho trải nghiệm nhào lộn xe cảnh sát đỉnh cao! Lái những chiếc xe tuần tra trên các siêu dốc cao vút, thực hiện những cú lộn nhào điên rồ trong thế giới 3D.

nodes.long_description: Staňte se mistrem kaskadérů v oblacích! Cop Drive přináší nejnapínavější simulátor policejní jízdy ve VR. Vlastnosti: Elitní policejní flotila, tratě na obloze s neonovým osvětlením, taktilní VR řízení a adrenalinové výzvy na Meta Quest.
nodes.short_description: Připoutejte se pro ultimátní policejní kaskadérský zážitek! Ovládejte výkonná auta na obřích rampách v oblacích, provádějte šílené triky a zdolávejte nemožné tratě v pohlcujícím 3D světě.

nodes.long_description: 在雲端挑戰中掌握正義之輪！體驗VR中最令人心跳加速的警車駕駛模擬。特色：精銳警車車隊、炫酷的霓虹天空賽道、觸感真實的VR駕駛控制、以及充滿挑戰的關卡進度，盡在 Meta Quest。
